summary: We also can't simply complain about social media. Need a better path forward. For me I am drawn to movements like #DoOO and #IndieWeb. Only way to fight the outrage machine is to be the better web. Encourage folks to own their domain. Be their own social network.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
We also can't simply complain about social media. Need a better path forward. For me I am drawn to movements like #DoOO and #IndieWeb.

Only way to fight the outrage machine is to be the better web.

Encourage folks to own their domain. Be their own social network.
